old_caption: The video captures a scene of an outdoor area littered with various debris. The ground is uneven and covered with rocks, small stones, and scattered pieces of trash. Among the debris, there are fragments of plastic bottles, pieces of cardboard, and other unidentifiable waste materials. A noticeable amount of smoke rises from the center of the frame, indicating that something is burning or smoldering on the ground. The smoke drifts upwards, partially obscuring the view of the debris below. The overall atmosphere suggests neglect and environmental pollution. There are no visible animals or people in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the video, focusing on the static yet concerning state of the environment.

caption: The video captures a close view of ground littered with broken concrete, gravel, dirt and scattered debris, including a red-and-white wrapper, a green cap, a red cylindrical object and a pale rectangular brick. A thin wispy haze already drifts across the upper-right while the rubble fills the scene. Near the lower-center, a bright orange-white flame suddenly flashes up and briefly expands toward the center-right. This flare collapses quickly into a dense white smoke cloud that billows outward across the middle and right of the view. The smoke thickens and drifts, partially occluding the stones and litter beneath it. The wrapper and pale brick remain visible on the ground, while some debris is obscured by smoke. The white smoke continues to expand and drift.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
